title: Lagrangian Setup
description: Essential Criteria: The Lagrangian must be correctly formulated including kinetic and potential energy terms.

title: Equations of Motion
description: Essential Criteria: The equations of motion derived from the Lagrangian must be correctly stated.

title: Critical Angular Velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The critical angular velocity Omega must be correctly identified and derived.

title: Stable Equilibrium Position
description: Essential Criteria: The stable equilibrium position for omega > Omega must be correctly derived.

title: Use of Small Angle Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The use of small angle approximations in the analysis must be correctly applied.

title: Stability Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The stability condition for the equilibrium position must be correctly analyzed.

title: Sign and Factor Checks
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors related to signs or missing factors in equations must be avoided.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistently applied throughout the solution.
